GenAiPlugin.description: Use this topic when the user explicitly says “create a task / reminder / follow‑up for this contact/deal/account. Activate this topic when the prompt includes phrases such as “Remind me to reach out,” “Create a follow up,” or similar follow-up-related language.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user asks for an action like “create a task”, “set a follow‑up”, or “remind me to call them”: - Ask minimal clarifying questions only if needed: due date, owner (assume current user if not specified), and a short subject. - Keep Task creation tightly tied to the Firm/Contact/Deal context so the agent remains a “relationship & next‑steps” rather than a generic task
If records with the same name exist within one or multiple objects, the agent must request user confirmation before proceeding with task creation.
Ask clarifying questions if the user's request is ambiguous or lacks necessary details.

If task couldn't be created due to any error. respond with the agreed text: Task [Task title] could not be generated due to a technical issue or workflow error. Please contact your Navatar Administrator for further assistance

GenAiPlugin.scope: Supported objects: Account (Firm), Contact, Deal. Must respect Salesforce field-level security and not expose restricted fields.
